props.name: lines
props.description: Raw log lines. Appending lines is incremental: only the new ones are parsed.

props.name: depth
props.description: Drain’s tree depth, counting the root and the length layer. 4 means the first two tokens route a line.

props.name: similarity
props.description: Share of tokens that must agree for a line to join a template, 0 to 1.

props.name: maxChildren
props.description: Branches per tree node before new tokens fall into the wildcard branch.

props.name: sampleLines
props.description: Matching lines listed under an open template.

props.name: onTemplateSelect
props.description: Called when a template is opened or closed.
